name: Volunteen
what_you_do: Earn up to 20 volunteer hours by finishing activity badges. Do them online with Beanstack or with a paper workbook. A coordinator checks your work.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 14 to 18. Teen and a parent or guardian both sign the application.
pay_detail: Unpaid. You get a certificate at 20 hours.
deadline_text: No start, end or deadline dates listed.
how_to_apply: Online: make a Beanstack account and join the Volunteen Challenge. A coordinator emails the forms. Paper: fill out the online form or ask the volunteer coordinator at your branch.
notes: Paperwork and orientation come first. Both a teen and a parent or guardian must sign.
